subject: EMEA/APAC: Last-mile risk flags and billing hold coordination
messages:
From: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@acmeenterprise.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 07:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: place invoices on hold while final SOW signs

Hi Vanessa,

We’re down to signatures on the SOW but procurement has flagged a discrepancy in the billing contact and we need a short hold on new invoices while our legal team finishes the amendment. I’ve attached the formal request from procurement (pdf). This is time-sensitive for our quarter-end close — can Redwood pause billing for any new consumption tied to the D-ACME-0321 PO until we confirm the amendment?

High level:
- Contract: D-ACME-0321 (SOW draft v3 attached)
- Requested hold window: up to 10 business days
- Contact: Liam O'Connor (procurement lead) — liam.oconnor@atlas-cloud.com

Thanks for the quick help; looping in our contact at Redwood to confirm next steps.

Best,
Aisha
Procurement Manager
Acme Enterprise

Attachment: acme_invoice_hold_request.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@acmeenterprise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: place invoices on hold while final SOW signs

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the attachment. I’ve read the request and we can pause new invoicing for amounts tied to D-ACME-0321 pending the signed amendment, but I need a quick operational confirmation so our finance and billing teams can apply the hold correctly.

Can you confirm these two items this morning:
1) Exact list of subscriptions/route IDs that should be excluded from new invoices (or confirm “all usage under D-ACME-0321”).
2) Final date we should mark as the start of the hold.

Internal team — please do the following as an action item:
- Marissa: confirm invoicing mechanics and whether this triggers a credit hold in our billing system or simply a manual skip for this PO.
- Monica: stamp the regional commit snapshot with the hold flag so FP&A sees the change for the EMEA rollup. I attached a working snapshot and will send a consolidated rollup later today.
- Sean: please triage any opportunities in the final-mile queue that may be impacted by a finance hold and add flags in HubSpot.

Proposed 30-min sync at 10:30 CET to align with Acme legal — Aisha, are you available? If not, send the procurement contact and we’ll coordinate.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the consolidated ask and our proposed wording for the amendment hold to ensure consistent messaging across EMEA and APAC accounts.

— Vanessa
Head of Sales Operations (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 11:05:00 +0000

On Sat, Dec 18, 2027 at 09:03 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the attachment. I’ve read the request and we can pause new invoicing for amounts tied to D-ACME-0321 pending the signed amendment...

Quick finance clarifiers:
- Mechanic: we will apply a manual invoice hold tied to the PO number. That prevents invoices from being generated but does not change usage accounting — we’ll show the usage as pending in the December rollup.
- Revenue recognition: legal hold may delay recognition for amounts > $50k until amendment signs; FP&A needs the hold flagged in the regional commit snapshot to avoid double-counting for the close.
- Cutoff to affect this quarter: we need confirmation before 2027-12-22 18:00 CET. After that, invoices already queued will proceed.

I’ll prepare the wording for the billing hold confirmation and share a one-line statement Aisha can sign-off on, to speed the process.

— Marissa
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Thomas <aisha.thomas@acmeenterprise.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlas-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: place invoices on hold while final SOW signs — consolidated next steps

Aisha / Liam — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming the operational plan and next steps below: 

Summary (for Acme internal & Redwood ops):
- Hold scope: all usage/invoicing tied to D-ACME-0321 (confirmed by Aisha).
- Hold start date: 2027-12-18 (effective immediately).
- Hold window: up to 10 business days, pending signed amendment.
- FP&A impact: Marissa will mark pending usage in the EMEA December snapshot; Monica will update the rollup.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Aisha / Liam: email confirmation on company letterhead or signature by 2027-12-22 18:00 CET (Aisha).
- Marissa (Finance): apply manual invoice hold and confirm that no new invoices will generate for the PO (ETA: 4 hours).
- Monica (FP&A): update regional_commit_snapshot_20271218.xlsx and flag impacted opportunities (ETA: by COB today).
- Sean (Sales): tag HubSpot opportunities and escalate any >$100k changes to leadership (ETA: 2 hours).

If we get signed confirmation before 22-Dec close, FP&A will exclude the amounts from the quarter commit; otherwise they’ll remain as queued and treated as invoiced. I’ve also uploaded the snapshot and the suggested billing-hold wording to the shared drive link in case you want to use it verbatim.

Please reply to confirm you received and agree with the plan; if anyone prefers a short call I’m available 10:30–11:00 CET today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
